stock.description: Sundy Service Group Co. Ltd operates as an investment holding company, delivering comprehensive property management solutions across China's Zhejiang province. The company manages a diverse portfolio of 58 properties, consisting of 38 residential units and 20 non-residential complexes. Its primary services encompass security, cleaning, landscaping, and the repair and upkeep of shared facilities and common areas. Additionally, Sundy Service Group offers value-added provisions to non-property owners, including consulting, sales support, and pre-occupancy services. For property owners and residents, the firm provides community-centric services such as property maintenance, waste removal, utility bill collection, renovation and decoration support, and management of community spaces. The company also has ventures in the hospitality industry, operating hotels and long-term rental apartments. Founded in 1995 with its headquarters in Hangzhou, PRC, the company rebranded from SUNDY HUIDU LIMITED to its current name in September 2017. Sundy Service Group Co. Ltd functions as a subsidiary of CMB Wing Lung (Trustee) Ltd.
